messages:
lia: quick ask — prepping the public statuspage + SMS for the 03:00 UTC change window (runtime + minor kernel patch). need two concise templates: an SMS-friendly one (<=160 chars) and an expanded statuspage body that includes rollback guidance and a note about dedicated capacity pinning. will A/B test subject lines. can someone draft options? :wave:

ben: put together quick drafts — keeping SMS ultra-short and status page clear. two variants below. use whichever one ops prefers.
```SMS (EN)
Redwood: Scheduled maintenance 03:00–03:30 UTC. Some requests may see brief errors or latency. No action needed; we’ll post updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```
```Statuspage - Short
Title: Scheduled maintenance — 03:00 UTC
We will perform a runtime and kernel patch during 03:00–03:30 UTC. Most customers will see no interruption; some requests may experience transient errors or higher latency. Our engineers will monitor and can rollback if needed. Updates at https://status.redwood.ai
```
```Statuspage - Expanded
Title: Scheduled maintenance — 03:00 UTC (runtime + kernel patch)
Window: 03:00–03:30 UTC
Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated serving clusters in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Private deployments unaffected.
Impact: Expected low impact. A subset of requests may return 5xx errors or elevated latency while we apply the patch. We will run canaries, and if service regressions are detected we will pause the rollout and roll back to the prior runtime within the window.
Rollback & Contact: If you experience issues after 03:00 UTC, please open a support ticket or email support@redwood.ai; for Dedicated customers, contact your SE for priority handling.
Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled change window created • id: cw-2026-03-14-03 • canary enabled • targets: hosted, dedicated (eu-west-1, us-west-2) • start: 2718208800 • link: https://internal.deploys.redwood.ai/cw-2026-03-14-03

carmen: quick notes — can we also prepare: 1) a Spanish SMS variant, 2) an internal ops short script for on-call to follow if canary fails, and 3) an explicit line for Dedicated customers about "pinning" (i.e., if you have pinned a runtime we will not force-upgrade; we will offer a scheduled window). I can draft the translation.

dave: two small wording asks — add a short sentence about model-serving fallbacks (e.g., we may route to a compatible quantized variant if the primary model is impacted) and explicitly state the SLA effect ("no SLA credit expected for this low-impact maintenance") or similar. also recommend including an explicit rollback contact: "pager on-call if >5% error rate sustained for 5m".

ben: updated combined copy below (final candidate). kept SMS short, statuspage expanded, plus internal ops runbook snippet.
```SMS (EN)
Redwood: Maintenance 03:00–03:30 UTC. Brief errors/latency possible. Updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```
```Statuspage - Final
Title: Scheduled maintenance — 03:00 UTC (runtime & kernel patch)
Window: 03:00–03:30 UTC
Scope: Hosted API and Dedicated clusters (eu-west-1, us-west-2). Private deployments unaffected unless you scheduled an on-prem package update.
Impact: Low impact expected. Some requests may see transient 5xx errors or higher latency. We will monitor system health and can pause or rollback the rollout if regressions appear. For Dedicated customers who have runtime pinning enabled, we will not force-upgrade; we will coordinate a separate scheduled update.
Rollback threshold: If error rate >5% sustained for 5 minutes during the window, on-call will pause the rollout and roll back to the previous runtime.
Contact & support: If you encounter issues, please open a support ticket or email support@redwood.ai. Dedicated customers: contact your SE or use the priority support channel.
Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```
```Internal ops snippet
- Start canary (eu-west-1) at T+0
- Monitor 1m error rate, p50/p95 latency
- If error rate >5% for 5m -> pause rollout, notify on-call, initiate rollback to previous runtime image
- Post-rollout: publish update to statuspage and send SMS batch for impacted customers
```

lia: this looks good. carmen — if you can add the Spanish SMS and a 1-paragraph Spanish statuspage, we can hand to comms. ben — please tag the scheduled statuspage update as "variant B" for the A/B subject line test. dave — noted on the fallback routing line, added to copy. i'll queue sends after translations land. :thumbsup:

carmen: working on translations now, will post in 10m.

ben: approved from my side — tagging @support-team and @oncall for final ack.

lia: acked. thanks everyone.
